Izuki, dismissive of the superstition, goes exploring—only to be attacked by a yokai in the woods. He's saved by a beautiful man named Haku, who claims to be the incarnation of a komainu guardian dog. He pledges himself to Izuki and begs him to be his master. Izuki refuses at first, wanting to return to the city as quickly as possible, but is swayed by Haku's lonely eyes and brings him back to the house. Gradually, he falls into a comfortable rhythm with the pushy but devoted Haku while living under the same roof, and Izuki wonders if he really wants to return to the city as he thought.

However, Haku harbors a secret that could put Izuki's life at risk. Will Izuki and Haku come together in the end, or will Haku succumb to the loneliness that he's held at bay for centuries...?

She was always afraid of her father, and she always hated herself – both in her looks and her personality. This moving essay manga depicts how her self-esteem slowly improves as her laid-back boyfriend validates her time and time again.

“My chin is huge. I want to file it off. I want to hammer it back in! I don't want anyone to see me like this.”

That's how I always felt. It's been 15 years now since I met my boyfriend. As if it were nothing, he would tell me that no, he likes that about me. I haven't completely overcome my insecurities, but I've come far enough that I can cope. Together with him.

The satirical saga of three artists seeking recognition. But there can be only one Artist.

A novelist, single, forty-four years old. A painter, divorced, forty-six years old. A musician, single, forty-two years old.

On the outer limits of relevancy in an arts culture that celebrates youth, these three men make up the artist group Arcade. Caught in circular arguments about what makes real art and concerned about the vapid interests of their younger contemporaries, none of them are reaping the benefits of success. But there’s always another chance to make it. When it comes time, out of the three, who will emerge as an acclaimed artist? More important, when one artist’s star rises, will he leave the rest behind? Woo Soo-han is what you would call the “complete package.” He’s young, physically fit, handsome, and has flourishing career to boot. He’s got everything anyone could ever desire, except maybe a relationship. That never bothered him, as work has always been his main priority. Everything changes when he meets his close hyung (and work subordinate)’s wife, Nayoung. From the moment he laid eyes on her, he felt an inexplicable attraction. Soo-han knew it was wrong and tried to forget about her, but when the two cross paths at a night club, and he ends up taking an intoxicated Nayoung back to her house. After discovering her husband isn’t home, Soo-han finds that he is no longer able to control his urges…

(Source: Lezhin X)

A university student, a model, a hacker, an auto repair apprentice…the list goes on, and these seemingly unrelated people have one thing in common. They are all from the same graduating class. One day, these 32 former classmates receive a suspicious text message from an anonymous sender. They’re promised $10,000 if they attend a class reunion held on an abandoned island. No one knows who sent the message or why, but they all participate. Some for fun, some for money, and some for the mystery. What will be awaiting them on the island?

(Source: Lezhin X)

156311.description:

That means making new friends, getting the hang of work, and with all the hot girls working here, maybe even land a girlfriend! Things are looking promising when he makes friends with a sweet girl named Hye-Sol. He just has to bide his time and not mess things up! But when a mystery girl, who he first saw in the woods, comes into the picture, could Gi-Hyeon’s wildest fantasies be ruined…or is this just the beginning?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

He’s reluctant about taking a job at a child-friendly café at first, but he soon realizes that it’s not only a place for kids to find playmates. After a while, he’s in luck when two of the hottest moms show interest in him. Yujin, a mother of two who still wants to be treated as an attractive woman, and Ahyun, a single mother who feels lonely raising a child on her own. Will this 21-year-old be able to find a way to juggle a relationship with the two cougars without being caught?

156391.description:
"I first met my stepmom when I was in elementary school. It was spring, 2 years after my real mom passed away..."

His father who has been raising him all by himself after he lost his wife, had remarried. His son Daiki who had a rebellious spirit, chose to accept living with his stepmother, for his father's sake. But the boy kept his distance as he didn't know how to approach her. So his stepmother Kaori slowly closed the gap with him.

"Just lengthen the 'ka' sound from Kaori, so please call me Kaa-san. (Mum)"

Kaori's gentle affection for him grew sincerely, and she would love him as if he were her own real son.
Daiki gradually accepted her as his mother, but at the same time he was also becoming attracted to Kaori, who was still a young and beautiful woman.

One day, he had just come home after getting caught in the rain, when he happened to walk in on his stepmother in just her undies, as she was in the middle of changing clothes. He kept his feelings of love hidden as he grew up, and twisted desires began to pile up while he tried his best to be a "good son" to a "kind stepmother", a relationship he did not want to destroy.

Daiki's secret love was supposed to end one day as just a "bitter first love", when his father's death suddenly changes everything...

This is a story of pure love growing between a stepmother and her son.

156426.description:
Taro is a dog lover who is overworked at a black company. One day, Taro got hit by a truck while trying to save a wolf-like creature that was about to get run over, and loses his life in the process. Taro wakes up in another world, and the Goddess gives him the right to be reborn as Fenrir, the strongest spiritual beast, with the power of a god. However, due to the whims of the Goddess, Taro is transformed into a cute (but powerful) creature that is "Fenrir" on the inside but "Shiba Inu" on the outside. He is sent to a humble princess who prayed to Fenrir, the divine wolf, believing him to be the messenger of salvation.

"Am I really that strong?" Unconvinced, Taro (Shiba Inu) sets off on an adventure with the princess.
But as they travel, his true strength is revealed.

The strongest doggy can steal away the skills of the opponents he bites, on his way to becoming unrivaled! A relaxed, fluffy fantasy!

(Source: HJ Bunko, translated)

156430.description:
Crow Titus is the greatest hero in the land. He’s gallant, brave, and adored by all—the perfect warrior. Or he would be if not for one minor detail: it’s all an act! He’d like nothing more than to take it easy and live a quiet life, preferably with an above-average girlfriend and a significant amount of wealth. Unfortunately, his cursed blade takes control of his body in its quest for its favorite meal—souls. But thankfully, it prefers to feast on the wicked. So in order to keep his curse a secret (and his sword satiated), Crow must keep up the act as a hero and slay the dangerous aetherborn that have been plaguing humanity for a thousand years. Otherwise, his sword might turn its hunger on the innocent and turn Crow into a mass murderer!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Emma has just taken her first step as a knight. Emma’s new job? Commander of a squad of useless layabouts. Just as her efforts start to change minds, a pirate base is discovered on Alias. What will happen when an elite force is sent in from the home planet to eliminate them?! An epic new tale of a failure’s rise to glory in the Intergalactic Empire begins!

156433.description:
I am the promised wife of victory!

“Sorry. I can’t answer your feelings for me.”

The person I had a crush on ended up in the same class as me, and I confessed my feelings to her in a burst of happiness, but was naturally rejected.

When I came home with such a low point in my life, the person who greeted me was…

The person who was supposed to have rejected me just a few minutes ago, Himegi Touka, is that person!

But she looked a bit older and sexier, and for some reason she was also wearing a wedding dress…

Apparently, Himegi herself is from six years in the future, and she claims to be married with me there, and she seems to have a purpose.

A life of cohabitation begins in order to happily marry the person who broke his heart in the future!

In this prestigious school warped by verbal abuse, dehumanization, and academic discrimination, an underclassman suddenly reaches out to me. With highlights in her black hair and a mischievous smile, she introduces herself as Kurumi Hoshimiya and forces me to take her hand. Kurumi involves me in her schemes, making me join her two-person resistance movement to tear down the school. Alone in an empty clubroom after class, we plot terrorism and commit sins, exchange kisses, and descend into depravity. Abandon right and wrong. Stop chasing grades. Rebel against the grown-ups. These are our recommendations for bad children.

(Source: Yen Press)

Yamase Fuyu, tired of his black job, runs into Ito, his ex-girlfriend from college, one day and invites her out for a drink. They talk about their old days and their new complaints, and just as he was thinking that this is a nice kind of friendship, they get carried away by the energy of alcohol and end up having a one-night stand. Fuyu regrets what he did, but Ito tells him, "Don't apologize. Don't say, 'Let's get it right.'" Ito, too, was tired of being forced by society to always act properly and adult-like. Thus, the two form a mysterious relationship where they only do fun things, without worrying about work, love, or other troublesome annoyances.

What awaited me after my reincarnation was a school life with aristocrats. I was reborn into a wealthy and arrogant noble family, but I try to behave as a modern person should, and act kindly to those around me without regardless of status.

The aristocratic lady Luna seems to appreciate my behavior. She is usually quiet and doesn't open up to anyone, but she eats lunch with me, and even though she is shy, she is willing to go on a date with me. Eventually, other girls and maids at the school also join our group. Beautiful, elegant, and unexpectedly sweet. The relationship with these ladies grows deeper and deeper...?

A sweet school love comedy, now begins!

Lido, the strongest of the Four Heavenly Kings, has infiltrated the human realm to carry out the Demon Lord's order. He was trying to gather information on the heroes, when he somehow ended up at a marriage agency. He is introduced to a beautiful girl named Rena, who is also a hero, and it turned out Lido and Rena were each other's first loves when they were children. Unaware of their past love, Lido and Rena get married, ostensibly for mutual benefits only, and they were supposed to live separate lives together.......

Their marriage is a sham to deceive the world, with maximum fighting power but zero love power!

156451.description:
Jiro Hoshimi calls himself the "bestest and cutest" cross-dressing boy. When he walks down the street in girls clothes, he catches everyone's eye with his beauty. He hides his cross-dressing from everyone at school, until one day he is found out by the girl sitting next to him, Shinnei Shiyoru. In exchange for keeping his secret, she asks him "to make me as pretty as Hoshimi-kun!" Now Shinnei's grand makeover is begins. Hoshimi gives her make-up, takes her shopping for clothes while dressed as a girl, and takes pictures of her looking good at a dessert shop. The too-cute Hoshimi-kun teaches Shinnei all his tricks. "But Hoshimi-kun is a boy......," she says, as Shinnei is still a little...... self-conscious of the opposite sex. This is a makeover romantic comedy in which a cross-dressing boy makes an introverted girl "cute"!

Humanity was once driven to the brink of extinction by the appearance of the "Demon Lord." It was the "Heroes" who defeated the Demon Lord and saved the world. In order to prevent the same thing from happening again, mankind decided to prepare for the resurrection of the Demon Lord by enacting the "Hero Recognition and Protection System," a system to keep several heroic braves on hand at all times. Time passed, and now... in an age when the threat of the Demon Lord has become a fairy tale, Miguel, the Kingdom's official for certifying heroes, and his partner, Dia, travel around the country looking for heroes. One day, Miguel hears a rumor of a "holy hero," a reincarnation of the hero who defeated the Demon Lord himself. When Miguel visits the mining city of Felicidad to investigate, he sees many miracles being performed by a girl they call the "Holy Hero"! Here is the start of a fantastical mystery about "miracles" and the "resurrection of heroes"!

(Source: Lanove Bunko, translated)

Note: Winner of the "Excellence Award" in the 13th Kodansha Lanove Bunko Newcomer Award.

During the summer vacation of my second year of high school, my first love, the college girl Kaede Kisaragi, asked me for help. Iori Kisaragi, who is three years younger than me and was like a little brother to me when I lived in the countryside, will be spending the whole summer vacation in the city with us this year――.

"Please just treat Iori like a brother. She even says she'll dress up like a boy while she's here."

When I met Iori again for the first time in three years, she clearly looked like a girl, but Iori thought she had succeeded in dressing up like a boy, and it's sweeter than I could've imagined. This is a summer youth flirtation love comedy with a childhood friend who is 100% pining for me!

What's going to happen when she inevitably gets a little carried away? Will her flames of justice burn down the whole world?

In an effort to reach her, Hina’s dad does something that changes her life—he gives her a DVD of the Vampire Cross anime! Hina is instantly obsessed, especially with the character Mao. But it’s difficult to fangirl as hard as she wants from her bedroom in Romania, so now Hina is out of the house and off to Japan to live her otaku dream!

(Source: VIZ Media)

Lua is a saintess candidate who possesses the power of healing. But her ability had one flaw: she could only heal others by transferring their wounds onto herself. Because of this, others bullied her, calling her the "Fallen Saintess." But it didn't bother Lua because her best friend Arianne always stood up for her.

One day, Lua's crush, Commander Garrett, was on the brink of death from a beast attack. Lua healed him, which left her on the verge of death. When she woke up, she learned that all the credit was given to Arianne, and she finally saw her best friend's true color. Devastated, Lua is lost and helpless when the second prince appears in front of her with a tempting offer. What would happen to Lua as she begins her new life as a villainess?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Her family seems to be keeping the cause of her father's death from her, and the servants all have fake names. Chervianne quickly learns how badly she misjudged everyone in the past, finding affection and betrayal in unexpected places. But will her newfound insight be enough to change her story and finally find love in her life?

After living a month with Youzou, Komiya is smitten. But Youzou is a great mystery. Apart from managing a bookstore, he also has another job that Komiya doesn't know much about, except that Youzou's clients all seem otherworldly. Komiya doesn't think about it much until an earthquake and rejuvenation water turns Youzou into a child. As it turns out, Youzou also runs a pawn shop of holy miracles for gods.

Arisa Date steps into the national spotlight as a professional mahjong player with a reputation already decided for her. She is seen as a face chosen for attention, someone placed there to be watched rather than believed. Every appearance is public. Every mistake travels farther than the work behind it. Illustrated by Ayato Sasakura, Vermilion Stella is a memoir about the private cost of being judged in public. It follows the strain of continuing when doubt surrounds you, the isolation of working while your failures are expected, and the quiet discipline required to return again and again while the world waits for confirmation that you do not belong. There is no sudden turning point, no speech or reinvention that changes everything at once. Instead, the story unfolds through time, as small results accumulate and perception begins to shift almost imperceptibly.

At its heart, this is a story about living inside someone else's version of you and the long, patient work of becoming visible as you are.

(Source: Mahjong Pros Publishing)

After another incident of his boss double-checking the contents of a note from Yokoi, he decides to do something about his poor penmanship. But in reality, Futoshi is getting beat up... by spirits! Amulets and talismans only go so far. What Futoshi really needs is a good luck charm...!

(Source: futekiya)

156652.description:
"The devil lives in our house."

Yeong-Cheol is an artist specialising in oil painting whose talent is recognised at home and abroad. His wife is a singer, and his son Hwan-Hui is a painting prodigy. Yeong-Cheol looks even more perfect with a seemingly perfect family...

However, as Hwan-Hui grows, Yeong-Cheol feels as though his son is trying to take his place. His anxiety grows when Hwan-Hui takes charge of the main painting for the joint exhibition they're preparing for together.

Seeing Hwan-Hui's aggressive expression, Yeong-Cheol decides to provoke his son into showing his true intentions using hostility, hoping to protect his position.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

156653.description:
When the boss of a notorious gang tells you to do something, you do it, and you do it well, even if that something changes from finding his ideal woman to BECOMING his ideal woman. Yasu, Boss Ginji's right- hand man, has only three words to say: You got it... And just like that, Yasu learns how to hypnotize Ginji to view him as Ginji's ideal type: strong, protective, gorgeous. The Boss falls in love at first sight. In his eyes, she (Yasu) is his very definition of perfect... in his eyes...

(Source: Futekiya)

156654.description:
Ryuuji Narukami is the number one host at his club and can make any woman blush with a simple exchange of words. And to his surprise, Ryuuji can have that effect on men, as well. When Saeyama, the landowner of the club where Ryuuji works, confronts him about seducing women who are "off-limits," he immediately takes a liking to the popular host's face. Saeyama's loyal right-hand man, Nejiro, gives Ryuuji an ultimatum: be his boss's lover, or die. What kind of messed-up game is he playing!? Just as Ryuuji thinks he has made the last decision of his life, he wakes up to find... a man with horns and a man who arises from the floor!? Where exactly is he? And how did he even get here?

(Source: Futekiya)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

A fat body type leads to a hellish military life due to sexual harassment from Yu-Hyeok, a senior military officer. Even after discharge, the memories of military service are so traumatising that living a normal life is impossible.

A familiar face appears on a recruitment poster. After seeing Yu-Heok, who ruined his life, living happily ever after, he decides to take revenge. That day, a plot to kidnap him and take revenge begins to unfold...

(Source: BOMTOON, translated and edited)

By night, they're the protectors of the Forbidden City who watch over the restoration of cultural relics! While they could've lived day to day on their cute appearances alone, they've chosen to bear the burden of preserving culture and safeguarding relics. They're the Forbidden City's Impurrial Cats!

Thus begins cyborg Ichigoki's wacky and aggravating misadventures with Misao, his mad scientist friend from childhood! A coming-of-age, buddy, gag manga from Seiji Hayashi, creator of I'm From Japan and Chikyuu Ningen Tera-chan!

Shuu Ito, 39, is still an active bicycle racer. His wife Kazumi, 35, is a housewife in her prime. Both Shuu and Kazumi have grown up, but the love of Japan's strongest couple still runs hot. And then there are the five handsome young men who hang out around the Ito household. They are new bicycle racers who look up to Shu as their mentor! The Ito family only grows stronger, as the new chapter of Keirin Yarou begins!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

156716.description:
Rieko is a video producer who has always prioritized work while leaving her love life on the back burner. Mei is a housewife who lost her happy marriage and her place to live, due to her husband's betrayal. Rieko told Mei, "If we are going to live together, let's do something different with our lives." Their life together, which began with the promise of change, began to take on color as one fell in love with the man of her dreams, one had a fling with a young singer, and more....... Finally, a light began to shine on the future they had lost sight of.

(Source: Comic Bridge, translated)

156717.description:
Childhood friends Serufu and Purin are being torn apart after enrolling in different high schools. As Serufu dwells on ways to mend their broken relationship, a lucky quirk of fate brings her to the DIY club. It may be on its last legs, but this encounter will turn out to be a defining moment of Serufu's youth.

This is a story about furniture, friendship, and life. About girls that constantly toil and tinker in spite of the setbacks they suffer. They relentlessly struggle to finish what they start with their own hands, never giving up as they carve out their futures... And you are about to see them take their first steps.

(Source: MANGA UP!)

156718.description:
Arata’s wish for a strong body that doesn’t get sick or hurt was granted when he was reincarnated on what he thought was an uninhabited island. While there aren’t humans living there, the island is full of Divine Beasts, Ancient Dragons, Vampires, and Monsters! Arata thought he was in a desperate situation right from the get-go, but apparently his strong body that doesn’t get sick or hurt is just too strong?!

(Source: MANGA UP!)

Nagatsuka Soujiro who works as a candy maker and his wife Makoto welcome a 4-year old Kuriko as their foster child. Soujiro, who doesn't have many memories of his childhood, worries whether he can properly take care of his foster daughter. This is a story about how people who are not related by blood become a family through making candy.

(Source: natalie.mu, translated)

A spin-off of the live action drama "DOGENGERS", this takes place 99 years later than the main story. The world is full of heroes and Hakata has become the safest place in Japan. The story begins when a young man, Kei Tsukumo, who aims to become a hero encounters a strange enemy..

(Source: natalie.mu, translated)

156723.description:
After getting into trouble at his elite alpha school, Haruto is transferred. His new classroom is a frenzy of excitement over this new student, but Miyabi, the student council president, is the only one who treats him with derision.

They have opposite personalities and life circumstances, but as the two of them clash they also grow attracted to one another. And Miyabi finds himself powerless against Haruto's alpha pheromones...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

156725.description:
A naturally handsome model and a university student whose handsome looks was gained from hard work.

After a certain incident, Oumi lost contact with Haku, his cool childhood friend whom he had always leaned on. But who would have thought that he would one day be attending the same university as his friend that he likes so much.

"Haku debuted as a model while we were apart and he has become someone who's very much adored by people in his surroundings. But here I am once again, only able to gaze at his blinding presence from afar."

"I want to be next to him. I want him to look at me with those eyes and do xx to me..."

Just what is the true nature of Oumi's feelings towards his ex-best friend, Haku?

(Source: Gentosha Comics, translated)

Jung-Woo, a kind-hearted soul, follows an injured pigeon he once helped to a hidden spot behind his school. There, he discovers his ideal type: Hae-In, peacefully napping with an angelic presence. Instantly captivated, Jung-Woo feels destined to be with Hae-In and approaches him—only to learn that Hae-In’s type is the opposite of who he is: a ruthless “insane top.” Eight years later, they meet again at a bookstore. A fierce showdown begins between Jung-Woo, determined to prove he’s become the “insane top” of Hae-In’s dreams, and Hae-In, intent on bringing back the sweet man he once fell in love with.

(Source: Lezhin US)
